designs.title: Holder carrier enclosure — provisional exterior

designs.title: Motor driver — native KiCad circuit study
designs.role: Fourteen components and 43 physical pin connections agree with the atopile board graph. This open block has four documented ERC boundary findings; supply, controller, motor connector and regenerative-energy clamp are not yet integrated.

designs.title: Compact enclosure — provisional exterior
designs.role: Earlier study, before PCB-mounted holders and independent shaft support. Initial compact direct-drive packaging candidate. Original parametric geometry; purchased-part fit and the holder-carrier alternative remain under review.

designs.title: Four layouts at the same scale
designs.role: Earlier study, before PCB-mounted holders and independent shaft support. Calculated front footprints from the original packaging study. Dimensions and purchased-part envelopes remain provisional.

designs.title: Compact enclosure — exploded study
designs.role: Earlier study, before PCB-mounted holders and independent shaft support. Enclosure and internal fit study. Motor, cells and PCB are reserved envelopes; attachment and drive details are still being developed.

designs.title: Compact direct drive — packaging study
designs.role: Earlier study, before PCB-mounted holders and independent shaft support. Compact direct drive with three cell columns and two depth layers. Provisional packaging study.

designs.title: Wide and shallow — packaging study
designs.role: Earlier study, before PCB-mounted holders and independent shaft support. Six cells across one depth layer. Provisional packaging study.

designs.title: Narrow with right-angle drive — packaging study
designs.role: Earlier study, before PCB-mounted holders and independent shaft support. Narrow footprint with a right-angle transmission envelope. Gears are not yet functional designs.

designs.title: Tall and shallow direct drive — packaging study
designs.role: Earlier study, before PCB-mounted holders and independent shaft support. Two vertical rows of three cells in a single depth layer. Provisional packaging study.

designs.title: PD12V6Mini — inherited power-board reference
designs.role: Existing e8s USB-C PD to 12.6 V power supply. This is not the new controller or a battery charger; no new hardware validation is implied.
